title: Tenma Saki — Because We're Together〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Our Starry Sky Leading to the Future

rows.Line: School SEKAI
Station

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, I'll see you two later!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! Let's go exploring again!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait a second!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Luka! Rin!
Do my eyes look red to either of you?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Your eyes...?
Yes, they look a little red.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh...
I had a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My mom's gonna worry so much if she sees me like this when I get home!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What do I do?! I have to come up with an excuse! A cat just happened to step on my face! Or a bird crashed into me!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Those might be hard to sell...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
J-Just try to relax, Sakki!
What if you told her that you weren't allowed to blink during practice?! That sounds more believable!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You also need to relax, Rin.
Why don't we all just take some deep breaths here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Breathe in... Breathe out...

rows.Speaker: Saki & Rin
rows.Line: Breathe in... Breathe out...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If keeping your mom from worrying is your objective, then it may be best for you to just sit tight here for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... You're probably right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, I should send her a message saying that I'm running a little late...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Are you feeling better now, Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I am. Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I feel like you've seen me cry a lot now, Luka...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That includes back then...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Back when...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: When we just got our band back together, I ended up pushing myself a little too hard.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I got a really high fever during practice, which forced Tsukasa to leave work in order to take care of me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Plus, I made my mom and dad worry so much...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There was so much I wanted to do back then... I felt like I had to do everything all at once.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because I was worried that I'd end up all alone again if I didn't. I thought that I only had a limited amount of time to have fun with my friends.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think Miku-P told me about that...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But what you're saying is way worse than what she told me...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It's okay, Rin.
At this point, it's all ancient history.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I still remember what you told me that time, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You wanted to get back what you lost.
That seems perfectly normal.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You felt that all those things couldn't wait.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “But you don't need to be in such a hurry to make up for that time. It's okay to take it easy.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I started feeling so much better after you told me that. All the tension I was feeling just seemed to disappear.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: At least, that's what I believe.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What do you think...?
Have I been able to put your advice to good use?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There have been times when I felt that you were pushing yourself too hard, but not because you were feeling rushed or anxious...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I believe your choices were well reasoned, sound and necessary.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I know you had to suffer at times, but you, Ichika and the others ultimately managed to become pros.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The worrisome girl I first met no longer exists. I feel like I can sit back and enjoy the show now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Cry*
I'm so happy for you, Sakki...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: R-Rin?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I didn't realize how hard you had it, Sakki. You had to try so hard and endure so much...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm so glad...!
For you, Sakki!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, please, stop...
If you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
If you keep saying that...
I feel so happy... I think I'm gonna cry...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Saki & Rin
rows.Line: *Cry*

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If you two aren't careful, your eyes are going to turn completely red.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Help us, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Alright, fine.
Come here, you two.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There, there.
